caption: A close, oblique view shows a transparent glass with a bright reflective rim resting at the upper-right on a white paper surface. The glass catches strong, mirror-like highlights along its curved rim. A soft diagonal shadow stretches from the glass toward the lower-left. Inside that shadow sits an orange refracted light patch accompanied by thin bright caustic arcs, while the paper's curved left edge remains visible. Over time the orange patch drifts gradually from the centre-left toward the centre-right. The caustic arc shifts and changes curvature as the lit boundary moves. The white paper's curved left edge appears to move toward the right, so that a brown wooden surface becomes visible at the top-left corner in later moments. The glass and shadow translate slightly rightward while the pattern morphs. All changes are slow and continuous, with no discrete start, stop, contact or completion occurring in view; whether the apparent motion is camera drift or actual movement of the glass cannot be determined.
